sections.label: 🐛 Fix
items: The 📊 unique-values dropdown's "Entity info - Area name" section rendered a country's real flag icon in place of the generic area glyph, and before the name (e.g. "[flag] » area name: Spain"). The generic glyph is now always shown, and the flag — when the area has one — is appended after the name instead: "[glyph] » area name: Spain [flag]".
